Animation and 3D was the category where Wizstar R1 led every model we compared it with, helped by how closely it followed prompts.

results.title: Seedance 2 Prompts Flagged? Fix Guide & Tips
results.content:
## The @ reference system: why uploads fail silently

A significant number of Seedance 2.0 problems are not filter issues at all. They are reference issues. Users upload images and video clips expecting the model to understand what each file is for, and the model does not assume anything. [...] Seedance 2.0's content filter does not work that way. It uses a language model to read your entire prompt as a single scene and make a judgment about what that scene represents. It is evaluating intent and context, not scanning for individual terms.

Think of it like a security guard at a film studio versus one at a bank. The same prop gun gets waved through the studio gate without a second thought, because the context makes the purpose obvious. At the bank, it is a completely different story. The object has not changed. The context has. [...] Some users have reported better pass rates by writing their scene description in Chinese while keeping any dialogue or on-screen text in English. The reasoning is that Seedance 2.0 was originally developed with strong Chinese-language training, so prompts written in Chinese may be interpreted with slightly different filter thresholds.

This is not a guaranteed fix and results vary, but if a well-constructed prompt keeps getting flagged despite solid cinematic framing, it is a low-effort thing to try. Run your scene description through any translator, keep the dialogue lines in English, and see if the output differs.

## Using Seedance AI' Text to Video
I signed up and used the Seedance AI product for a few weeks with the Premium Plan for $49.90 per month. I opted for the paid rate as there is little you can do on the free one. Tried different "Text to Video" options - the Seed Plus model (320 credits per video), Wan2.1 Plus (200 credits) for scenarios with a bug in the woodland that I ran through ChatGPT. Since Seedance couldn't make the video I needed, I simplified the script - and still didn't get the video I wanted. Not in any model.. I contacted tech support asking for a refund, but no one answered and the money was not refunded. My opinion is while Seedance can't perform realistic video generation as written and needs serious refinement, the support is also lame.

## I subscribed to Seedance AI's
I subscribed to Seedance AI's “Unlimited Video” plan for $89.9, expecting to generate high-quality videos. In reality, I could only generate 20 videos, each with very poor resolution and file sizes (about 1.5MB per 10 seconds). There is no proper HD export.  
  
Even worse, their refund policy is misleading. If you use just a few credits, you lose all refund eligibility — even within 3 days of purchase.  
  
This experience was very disappointing, and other creators should be cautious before subscribing. The pricing is steep and the results are far from what's advertised.
